project_type: Flutter app (Dart 3.14 beta), single package, no monorepo
build_system: flutter build / flutter run. build_runner for Drift codegen only (drift_dev). No codegen for routing — kaisel uses sealed classes without generation. Run `flutter pub get` after pubspec changes.
test_framework: flutter_test (package:flutter_test). No test directory exists yet; run `flutter test` to execute tests.
build_command: flutter pub get && flutter build apk --debug
verification_instructions: 1. Run `flutter pub get` after pubspec edits. 2. Run `flutter analyze` — must exit 0 with no errors. 3. Run `flutter build apk --debug` to confirm compilation. 4. For runtime checks, use `flutter run`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart and lib/l10n/app_localizations_en.dart are generated by `flutter gen-l10n` (triggered automatically by `flutter pub get` / build when l10n.yaml is present). Drift generated files (*.g.dart) are produced by `dart run build_runner build`. Neither is needed for this task.
environment_constraints: Flutter channel beta (3.49.0-0.2.pre). SDK constraint ^3.14.0-211.1.beta. Do NOT switch channels. Do NOT use flutter_scene APIs in this feature set — that is a separate concern. Do NOT restart dev server. Windows PowerShell environment.
contribution_requirements: Do not modify: lib/main.dart, lib/core/errors/reporter_impl.dart, lib/core/utils/sort_extension.dart, lib/core/config/build_mode/ (all files), lib/core/config/flavor/ (all files), lib/core/config/flavor_config.dart. Fill in lib/routing/app_router.dart (the initial: and switch builder stubs). Add new packages to pubspec.yaml with exact versions.
key_patterns: State management: CubitSignal<S> from bloc_signals (extends BlocSignalBase, uses initCubitSignal + emit in constructor). UI reactivity: SignalBuilder(builder: (ctx) => ...) or SignalStatefulWidget — both from signals_flutter, re-exported via bloc_signals_flutter. BlocSignalProvider wraps a CubitSignal and provides it via context.read<T>() / context.watch<T>(). Routing: sealed class AppRoute extends KaiselRoute; route subclasses are final class X extends AppRoute with @override List<Object?> get props => [field]; KaiselRouterConfig<AppRoute>(initial: const HomeRoute(), builder: (ctx, route) => switch(route) { HomeRoute() => ..., PostRoute(:final postUrl) => ... }). appRouterConfig.router.push(PostRoute(postUrl: url)) for navigation. Config pattern: const String.fromEnvironment with defaultValue for compile-time config.
directory_structure: lib/ — app code. lib/core/ — shared utilities (config, errors, utils). lib/features/ — feature slices (grid, product, cart, wishlist, location, search). lib/routing/ — app_router.dart only. lib/l10n/ — generated i18n. android/app/src/main/ — AndroidManifest. pubspec.yaml at root.
